document: IStructE/Concrete Society SMDS Chapters 1–5 — Drawing Conventions

reinforcement_notation_on_drawings.format: N H D - M - S L

fields.L: location/layer code (e.g. B1, T1, F1, N1)

reinforcement_notation_on_drawings.full_example_decoded: 20 No. H16 bars, mark 63, at 150mm centres, bottom face outer layer
reinforcement_notation_on_drawings.note_beams_columns: Bar centres and location usually not required for beams and columns — see 6.3 and 6.4

layer_notation.note: Must be illustrated by a sketch on relevant drawings as contractor may not be familiar

plan_view_conventions.section_position: horizontal cut assumed immediately above surface of structural arrangement
plan_view_conventions.column_size_notation: overall concrete size with clear indication of orientation
plan_view_conventions.beam_notation: beam reference + h×b, preferably at centre of span
plan_view_conventions.downstand_beam_soffit: dotted line plots lowest beam soffit profile

elevation_conventions.section_position: vertical cut immediately adjacent to element under consideration

section_conventions.content: only material in cutting plane shown — no features beyond
section_conventions.placement: as near as possible to the detail it relates to

dimension_placement.reading_direction: from bottom or right-hand side of drawing
dimension_placement.placement: near to and above the line, not through the line
dimension_placement.on_GA: all setting-out dimensions and member sizes
dimension_placement.on_rebar_drawing: only dimensions necessary for correct location of reinforcement

levels_notation.on_section: projected beyond drawing with closed arrowhead

holes_on_drawings.hole_through_beam_or_wall: indicate level to bottom of hole

joints_on_drawings.section_for_clarification: required if not clear from plan

steps_in_level.plan_representation: sectional hatching at change in level

framing_plan_notation.column_ref: at intersection of grid letters and numbers (e.g. B2 at grid B, line 2)
framing_plan_notation.beam_ref: column ref + suffix (e.g. B21 for first beam spanning up in panel B2)
framing_plan_notation.beams_on_grid_lines: labels may be omitted; described as 'beams along grid line B/1 to 3'

bar_identification_visual.grade_A_500: two or more series of parallel transverse ribs, same angle and direction each series
bar_identification_visual.grade_B_500: two or more series of parallel transverse ribs; one series at contrary angle (2-3 rib series) or two at contrary angle (4 rib series)
bar_identification_visual.grade_C_500: same as Grade B but ribs alternate between higher and lower angle (differing by at least 10deg)
bar_identification_visual.CARES_mark: dot-dash-dot mark plus country and mill identity

flat_slab: plan showing required steel areas by grid zone
